requirements.title: DATA contains one or more initialization sets, optionally separated by commas
requirements.definition: DATA is followed by a required data-stmt-set and zero or more further sets. The comma before each additional set is optional. DATA specifies initialization, not an executable assignment, even when an otherwise permitted statement-order context places it in an execution part.

pending.missing-first-set: PENDING diagnostic/control pair in D0: DATA alone, repaired only by appending i /7/ for the already declared scalar. Require a missing DATA set cause and an admitted repair, not an unrelated undeclared name, source-form failure or generic parser crash.
pending.statement-kind-owner: PENDING finite source graph R840 -> R507/R510 and5.3.1-.2/8.4. DATA can occur among executable statements but does not execute there; B.3.5 marks that placement obsolescent. A warning for obsolescence is not a malformed-DATA diagnostic. S8.6.7-004's planned initial-state observation is distinct from this source classification; no no-op classifier.

requirements.oracle:
Compile admission or a source-minimal syntax diagnostic/control pair in complete D0 units; source-kind relationships need bound statement locations and their original owners.

DATA statement fixture family: one complete positive-control program reaches one set, comma-separated sets and adjacent sets without the optional comma. Five distinct nonzero INTEGER objects are checked after normal execution, so syntax admission is tied to the actual DATA statements and not to declaration initialization or default zero storage.
requirements.oracle_limitation:
Required capability to report is not mandatory fatal rejection, fixed English, nonzero status or printed R840. Unsupported facilities, crashes, resource errors and an obsolescence warning alone do not corroborate the local syntax cause. All facets are pending.

DATA statement fixture family boundaries: only `single-set`, `sets-with-comma`, `sets-without-comma` are represented by this generator. All other facets, diagnostics, source-use links, reviews and the existing DATA position effect fixtures remain independently managed. Generation grants no review or baseline update.

requirements.title: Each DATA set has nonempty object and value lists between two slashes
requirements.definition: A set consists of a data-stmt-object list, a slash, a data-stmt-value list and a closing slash. R401 defines nonempty comma lists. A syntactically present list can expand to an empty sequence under p7; syntactic nonemptiness and expanded cardinality are different predicates.

pending.opening-slash: PENDING diagnostic/control: DATA i 7/ with prior INTEGER i, repaired by inserting only the slash before 7. All declaration, value-type and eventual one-to-one premises are fixed; require the DATA-set delimiter cause.
pending.closing-slash: PENDING diagnostic/control: DATA i /7 followed by the statement terminator, repaired only by adding the final slash. No following statement, continuation or source-form repair may substitute for this cause.
pending.required-object-list: PENDING diagnostic/control in D0 with INTEGER z(0): DATA /0*7/, repaired by inserting only z before the first slash. Both prospective expanded lengths are zero, avoiding a separate nonzero count mismatch as the purported cause of the missing syntactic object list. This is compile-only, not a zero-array runtime effect.
pending.required-value-list: PENDING diagnostic/control with prior INTEGER z(0): DATA z //, repaired only by inserting 0*7 between the slashes. The repaired value list is nonempty but expands to zero constants. Do not count an equal-length policy report as the required missing-list syntax report.
pending.list-expansion-graph: PENDING finite R841 -> R401/R842/R846 graph for scalar pairs and the zero-array/zero-repeat context. Bind list-item spans before expansion and computed sequence members after expansion. Current supplementary-target links do not supply arbitrary numbered-wrapper reuse; do not clone one source to simulate that mechanism.

requirements.oracle:
Matched, otherwise conforming compile controls and exact slash/list omissions; distinguish syntax-list length from expanded-sequence length.

DATA statement fixture family: one complete positive-control program reaches a two-object and two-value DATA set between slashes and observes the two nonzero initial values. This establishes only the selected matched-list control; empty-list and slash-omission diagnostics remain separate.
requirements.oracle_limitation:
No runtime query of a zero-sized object proves this grammar. Empty-list repairs must not leave a p8 mismatch. Diagnostics need a local cause, not a mandatory rule code or fatal status.

DATA statement fixture family boundaries: only `matched-lists` are represented by this generator. All other facets, diagnostics, source-use links, reviews and the existing DATA position effect fixtures remain independently managed. Generation grants no review or baseline update.

requirements.title: A DATA object is a variable or a DATA implied DO
requirements.definition: The alternatives are variable and data-implied-do. C879 narrows the variable alternative to a designator with constant addressing expressions; C878/C880/C881 further restrict eligible entities and pointer paths. A variable is a data object, not a direct procedure-pointer entity.

pending.variable-designators: PENDING compile/positive-control contexts in complete D0 units: a scalar INTEGER; a fixed INTEGER array; a constant triplet section; a scalar public INTEGER component of a previously defined no-default-initialization type; and a constant substring of a fixed default CHARACTER variable. Supply exactly the needed scalar constants and initialize no selected part twice. Canonical R901 designator forms are not new local grammar copies.
pending.implied-do-alternative: PENDING compile/positive-control: prior INTEGER a(2), then DATA (a(i), INTEGER :: i=1,2) /11,22/. R843 owns the control syntax, R844 the object alternatives, and19.4 the statement entity; no ordinary undeclared i is assumed under IMPLICIT NONE.
pending.pointer-versus-procedure-role: PENDING finite role proof from3.41/3.42/3.104.1-.2/3.151 and9.1-.2: a whole data pointer initialized with NULL() is a possible DATA variable; a direct procedure pointer is a procedure, not this variable alternative. R848 has no initial-proc-target alternative. Keep procedure-pointer declaration initialization under15.4.3.6; a derived object containing a procedure-pointer component is a separate constant-constructor question, not blanket direct DATA admission.
pending.object-wrapper-graph: PENDING source graph R842 -> R902/R901 or R843, with C878-C885 attached in their actual roles. The graph must distinguish a constant subobject, function reference, scalar variable and component path; name text, generic wrong-context errors and no-op executions cannot establish that distinction.

requirements.oracle: Bounded source/role relationships and complete admitted declarations, retaining every inherited constraint and canonical grammar owner.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Do not use a function with a nonpointer result, direct procedure pointer, undefined dereference or invalid entity role as a supposedly conforming control. No automatic source-use or wrapper-link credit.

requirements.title: A DATA implied DO has an object list and constant integer loop control
requirements.definition: Parentheses enclose a nonempty data-i-do-object list followed by a comma, optional integer-type-spec with double colon, the data-i-do-variable and equals, two scalar integer constant expressions, and an optional third such expression introduced by a comma. Constant-expression rules permit an appropriate current or enclosing DATA index; the nonzero step and iteration interpretation come from the referenced DO semantics, not a new local numbered constraint.

pending.inherited-index-type: PENDING compile/positive-control in a complete program with INTEGER a(2), i declared before DATA (a(i),i=1,2)/11,22/. The DATA index is a separate scalar statement entity using the inherited integer type, not an executable assignment to the enclosing i.
pending.explicit-integer-type: PENDING compile/positive-control for DATA (a(i),INTEGER :: i=1,2)/11,22/ with prior INTEGER a(2) under IMPLICIT NONE. A named kind variant uses a supported previously defined integer kind, never an arbitrary kind number or assumed ordering of kind values.
pending.explicit-step: PENDING compile/positive-control for prior INTEGER a(3) and DATA (a(i),INTEGER :: i=3,1,-1)/31,21,11/. All three selected subscripts are in bounds and the repeat/value count is three. Numeric effects belong to the separate sequence plan, not this admission.
pending.nested-dependent-limit: PENDING compile/positive-control with prior INTEGER a(2,2) and DATA ((a(i,j),INTEGER :: j=1,i),INTEGER :: i=1,2)/11,21,22/. The enclosing i is a permitted constant-expression primary within its implied DO under10.1.12p1(13). Only a(1,1),a(2,1),a(2,2) are initialized; do not read the other element.
pending.control-comma: PENDING diagnostic/control in the two-element integer context: omit only the comma between a(i) and the control i=1,2; restore it. The index is already declared INTEGER, all limits are constant and the two values match the repaired expansion. Require that separator cause.
pending.type-double-colon: PENDING diagnostic/control with prior INTEGER a(2), i: DATA (a(i),INTEGER i=1,2)/11,22/, repaired only by inserting :: after INTEGER. Do not substitute a REAL index, missing declaration, changed trip count or unrelated kind failure.
pending.limit-and-step-owner: PENDING finite proof for all three scalar-int-constant-expr slots through R1032/C1014 and R403/C401. Include literal bounds, a previously defined integer parameter, and a qualifying SIZE inquiry on a previously specified constant-bound array. Ordinary variable values are not constant, but specification inquiries are not banned merely because their argument is a variable. Canonical expression diagnostics retain their owners.
pending.step-zero-owner-gate: PENDING source-only zero-step contrast to a unit step under11.1.7.4.1p1(1), with otherwise fixed integer declarations and bounds. A zero third expression satisfies the local syntactic expression class but violates the nonnumbered DO interpretation; do not relabel a prose/policy report as a mandatory R843 violation or run an invalid expansion.

requirements.oracle: Complete typed integer contexts with exact finite index sequences and matching value counts. Local punctuation diagnostics are separate from canonical expression/type/DO restrictions.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No integer overflow in loop-parameter conversion/count arithmetic, zero step, out-of-bounds reference, wrong scope or unsupported F2023 typed-index syntax can corroborate a different predicate. Admission is not iteration-effect coverage.

requirements.title: A DATA implied-DO object is an array element, scalar component or nested implied DO
requirements.definition: The alternatives are array-element, scalar-structure-component and data-implied-do. They are narrower than R842's general variable alternative. C882/C883 require variables, C884 requires a subscript list in the scalar-component path, and C885 restricts the subscripts and index scope.

pending.array-element: PENDING compile/positive-control: fixed INTEGER a(2), DATA (a(i),INTEGER :: i=1,2)/11,22/. No constant array, vector-subscript duplication, pointer path or unknown bound is involved.
pending.indexed-parent-component: PENDING compile/positive-control: a local type with a public plain INTEGER field and no default initialization, plus a(2) of that type; DATA (a(i)%field,INTEGER :: i=1,2)/11,22/. The final part has no subscript and is scalar; the parent part supplies C884's subscript list.
pending.nested-implied-do: PENDING source/compile admission of the bounded two-by-two nested context from R843, with different i/j statement entities. Preserve the inner and enclosing scopes, permitted constant-expression primaries, and exact three-item value list.
pending.bare-scalar-exclusion: PENDING diagnostic/control with prior scalar INTEGER x and INTEGER a(1): DATA (x,INTEGER :: i=1,1)/7/, repaired by replacing only x with a(1). Both hypothetical expansions have one scalar and no target was otherwise initialized. The forbidden form is a bare scalar in this object slot, not an unsupported implied DO.
pending.whole-array-wording-gate: PENDING finite grammar/expansion reconciliation: p5 mentions unqualified array names in object roles, but that text does not waive R844's admitted forms or C401/C884. Do not invent a conforming bare-whole-array implied-DO object or use it as a control. The selected witnesses use array elements, scalar indexed-parent components and nesting; any additional interpretation requires original-source adjudication.

requirements.oracle: Admit each actual alternative with all role predicates satisfied; use a one-iteration bare-scalar contrast to avoid hidden cardinality changes.
requirements.oracle_limitation: A scalar structure component without any subscript path fails C884 even though its surface alternative exists. A named constant element fails C882/C883. Neither failure can stand in for R844 admission.

requirements.title: The DATA index uses the canonical DO-variable grammar
requirements.definition: A data-i-do-variable is a do-variable, inheriting R1124/C1121 and scalar/name conventions. Its DATA statement-entity scope and attributes come from19.4, including explicit integer-type-spec or inherited integer typing and the absence of other attributes.

pending.integer-index-admission: PENDING source/compile admission for the inherited-Integer and explicit INTEGER :: i controls already specified at R843. Record the actual DO-variable token and type origin; do not create a duplicate no-op program just for this alias.
pending.noninteger-index-owner: PENDING canonical C1121 relationship: prior REAL x and INTEGER a(1), with DATA (a(1),x=1,1)/7/. The fixed subscript1 avoids an additional noninteger-subscript error. The source-minimal control adds INTEGER :: before x in the implied-DO control, overriding only the statement entity's type under19.4p5. Any diagnostic must identify the index type, not use an unrelated real-value oracle; the numbered owner remains C1121.
pending.index-entity-identity: PENDING finite source/state plan with an enclosing scalar INTEGER i explicitly initialized to23, and a distinct DATA index of the same spelling initializing a(2).19.4 permits this scalar-name exception and forbids same-named nested statement entities. A later runtime observation may check the separately defined outer i remains23, but that meaning stays owned by19.4; no DATA-index final value, implicit declaration of outer i, duplicate program or automatic numbered link.

requirements.oracle: Canonical syntax/type and scope relationships bound to concrete DATA control tokens, with independent integer-context repairs where feasible.
requirements.oracle_limitation: The alias does not create another integer type restriction or scope runtime classifier. Current source-use and supplementary-target link mechanisms do not automatically cover this numbered wrapper.

requirements.title: DATA objects are not coindexed variables
requirements.definition: Neither a data-stmt-object nor a data-i-do-object may be a coindexed variable. A local coarray object without an image selector is not excluded merely because it is a coarray.

pending.direct-coindexed-object: PENDING diagnostic/control in a complete module with INTEGER a[*], no other initialization and implicit SAVE: DATA a[1]/7/, repaired by deleting only [1]. Corank1 and image selector1 are well formed; require a DATA coindexing cause, not disabled coarrays, unsupported declaration syntax or a runtime image error.
pending.implied-do-coindexed-element: PENDING diagnostic/control with module INTEGER a(1)[*]: DATA (a(1)[1],INTEGER :: i=1,1)/7/, repaired by deleting only [1]. The object remains an in-bounds scalar array element, the index is unused but valid, and both counts are one.
pending.local-coarray-control: PENDING compile/positive-control qualification of the two repaired local-object forms under an actual coarray-capable F2023 declaration profile. C823/C824/C826 and explicit coshape remain satisfied. No allocation, synchronization, cross-image execution or image-count oracle is claimed.

requirements.oracle: Single image-selector deletions in otherwise valid, saved, nonallocatable intrinsic coarray declarations.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No native coarray execution is part of this source packet or these grammar controls. An unsupported-facility diagnostic is not the required role-specific report.

requirements.title: The variable branch uses a designator with constant addressing expressions
requirements.definition: A variable used as a data-stmt-object must be a designator. Every subscript, section subscript and substring endpoint in it is a constant expression. This is the R842 variable branch; implied-DO subscripts have their separate C885 context, including permitted DATA-index primaries.

pending.function-reference-excluded: PENDING causal diagnostic/control qualification in a complete main program with a local saved INTEGER TARGET t and an internal function f returning an INTEGER data pointer associated with t: DATA f()/7/, repaired only to DATA t/7/. t has no other initializer; the function would return a live target but is not executed by DATA. R902/C902's data-pointer-result alternative is satisfied before C879 removes it. Require the non-designator cause; do not use a nonpointer function, already initialized target, imported receiver or undefined-pointer query.
pending.variable-subscript: PENDING diagnostic/control in D0 with INTEGER :: a(2), k=1: DATA a(k)/7/, repaired only by replacing k with1. The subscript value is defined and in bounds but is not a constant expression; initializing k does not make it PARAMETER. No other element is read or initialized.
pending.section-bound: PENDING diagnostic/control with INTEGER :: a(2), k=1: DATA a(k:k)/7/, repaired to a(1:1) by replacing the two occurrences of the same forbidden bound expression. Both forms denote one element for the supplied state; require the nonconstant section-addressing cause, not a count mismatch. Lower/upper occurrences are recorded separately, not fictional independent failures.
pending.section-stride: PENDING diagnostic/control with INTEGER :: a(3), k=2: DATA a(1:3:k)/11,33/, repaired only by replacing k with2. All selected indices and the nonzero stride are valid; the violated predicate is constancy. A zero-stride contrast belongs to9.5.3.4.2, not this case.
pending.substring-start: PENDING diagnostic/control with CHARACTER(4) c and INTEGER :: k=2: DATA c(k:3)/'BC'/, repaired only by replacing k with2. One substring contributes one variable regardless of its character length; selected storage is not otherwise initialized.
pending.substring-end: PENDING diagnostic/control with CHARACTER(4) c and INTEGER :: k=3: DATA c(2:k)/'BC'/, repaired only by replacing k with3. No range or length incompatibility is introduced. Never read the uninitialized characters outside the selected substring.
pending.constant-inquiry-and-vector-admission: PENDING compile/positive-control contexts using a previously defined integer PARAMETER subscript, a qualifying SIZE inquiry on a prior constant-bound array, and a constant unique vector subscript [3,1] for INTEGER a(3), with exactly two DATA values.10.1.12 governs inquiries,9.5.3 governs vector shape/order, and8.4 forbids overlapping initialization; no blanket variable-name ban or duplicate-vector control.

requirements.oracle: Complete local declarations, constant-expression contrasts that preserve role/range/cardinality, and a separately qualified non-designator function-reference pair.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Ordinary defined values are not constant expressions, but valid specification inquiries may mention variables. Generic unsupported expressions, out-of-bounds errors and DATA-index scope failures are not substitute reports. No invalid program is run.

requirements.title: DATA designators exclude specific entity roles and retain the named-COMMON exception
requirements.definition: A variable whose designator is a direct or implied-DO DATA object is not a dummy argument, USE- or HOST-associated entity, a named-COMMON member unless the DATA is in BLOCK DATA, a blank-COMMON member, a function name or result name, an automatic data object, or an allocatable variable. Declarations, entity identity, implicit SAVE and initialization count must be resolved before attributing a diagnostic to one role.

pending.dummy-scalar: PENDING diagnostic/control: a complete external subroutine s(x), prior INTEGER x without INTENT or other dummy-only attributes, then DATA x/7/. Delete only x from the dummy list for the control, leaving an eligible local INTEGER. No invocation of the invalid unit and no undefined actual argument.
pending.dummy-array-element: PENDING diagnostic/control: subroutine s(a), INTEGER a(1), DATA (a(1),INTEGER :: i=1,1)/7/. Remove only a from the dummy list; extent, index, count and type stay fixed. This exercises the implied-DO-object role without an array-count change.
pending.use-associated-identity: PENDING identity/cause-qualified pair: module m declares public INTEGER i with no initializer. A separate subroutine uses ONLY:i and has DATA i/7/ under default implicit integer typing, without a conflicting local declaration. Repair only by renaming the imported entity in USE (local_i=>i), so DATA i creates a distinct local implicit INTEGER. Confirm resolved identities and14.2.2p9 interaction; a generic attribute/redeclaration report is not isolated C880 evidence.
pending.host-shadowing-gate: PENDING finite source proof, not a guessed negative:19.5.1.4p2(9) makes a wholly/partially DATA-initialized name local and can hide a host homonym. A plain inner DATA i/7/ is therefore not automatically initialization of the host i. A future forbidden-host witness must prove it remains host associated and supply a valid one-predicate repair without an IMPORT, declaration or scope conflict. No diagnostic credit until that gate is resolved.
pending.named-common-outside-block-data: PENDING diagnostic/control in a complete external subroutine: INTEGER x; COMMON /box/ x; DATA x/7/. Remove only the COMMON statement for the control. There is no other declaration/initialization of box in this bounded program. Require forbidden DATA initialization of a named-COMMON member outside BLOCK DATA, not an obsolescence warning.
pending.block-data-admission: PENDING compile/positive-control: one named BLOCK DATA unit declares the entire named block /box/ with a single INTEGER member x and DATA x/7/. Match unit/end names, initialize no local non-COMMON object and use no forbidden block-data declarations. No duplicate block-data definition or inferred SAVE/ABI runtime effect.
pending.blank-common: PENDING diagnostic/control in a complete subroutine with INTEGER x; COMMON x; DATA x/7/. Remove only COMMON x for the control. Blank COMMON's lifetime properties do not permit initialization; a named-common BLOCK DATA exception cannot repair a blank block merely by moving the statement.
pending.function-result: PENDING diagnostic/control: complete INTEGER function f() has separately declared local INTEGER v, DATA f/7/, and executable f=9 before return. Repair only the DATA object f to v. Function/result-role exclusion is the cause; the function is otherwise typed and returns a defined result. The invalid function is never executed.
pending.separate-result: PENDING analogous diagnostic/control for INTEGER function f() RESULT(r), local INTEGER v, DATA r/7/, then executable r=9. Replace only r by v in DATA. This keeps the result name distinct from the procedure name and avoids an undefined-return or literal-count oracle.
pending.function-name-category-gate: PENDING role proof for the function-name exclusion. The no-separate-result case above also denotes its result variable; a bare procedure name with a separate RESULT is not automatically a valid R842 variable. Do not manufacture a second isolated C880 case by hiding a variable/designator grammar violation or direct procedure-pointer role mismatch.
pending.automatic-save-cause-gate: PENDING source/control with a scalar automatic CHARACTER(n) local in a subroutine whose INTEGER n is a dummy, and DATA c/'X'/. Repair only the length expression n to1, keeping the scalar count one. DATA also implies SAVE, so the invalid automatic object activates C814. An automatic/SAVE report alone belongs to that canonical predicate and cannot be asserted as independent C880 corroboration; no invalid execution or unknown array-count contrast.
pending.allocatable-scalar: PENDING diagnostic/control with a local scalar INTEGER, ALLOCATABLE :: x and DATA x/7/. Remove only ALLOCATABLE for the control. Shape/cardinality are unchanged and no other initializer exists. Require the excluded allocatable DATA role; do not allocate, dereference or query an invalid initialized allocatable.

requirements.oracle: Role-specific complete units and minimal repairs, with explicit source/cause gates where DATA changes identity or necessarily activates a second restriction.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No generic wrong-context/unsupported-facility/error-count result is corroboration. Host, automatic and bare-function branches do not become isolated cases merely because a compiler rejects them. COMMON/ordering obsolescence reporting is separate; required C880 reporting is not forced fatal rejection or a printed code.

requirements.title: A pointer in a DATA object designator must be its entire rightmost part
requirements.definition: For a direct variable DATA object or implied-DO object, a pointer may occur in the object designator only as the entire rightmost part-ref. Earlier pointer hops and subscripted or substring-selected pointer targets are different from initializing a whole final pointer's association.

pending.whole-pointer-admission: PENDING compile/positive-control with a prior INTEGER pointer p, uninitialized elsewhere, and DATA p/NULL()/. An array pointer p(:) similarly contributes one pointer, not elements; use a separate complete context with the same one-value count. No dereference or undefined-status inquiry.
pending.rightmost-pointer-component: PENDING compile/positive-control: local type t has INTEGER, POINTER :: p without component initialization; scalar t object x and a saved INTEGER TARGET v are declared before DATA x%p/v/. x is nonpointer, the rightmost p is entire, and v meets C770. This changes association, not a target value through a pointer.
pending.pointer-element-exclusion: PENDING diagnostic/control in a complete module with INTEGER,TARGET,SAVE :: t(2) (no value initializer) and INTEGER,POINTER :: p(:)=>t: DATA p(1)/7/, repaired only to DATA t(1)/7/. p has a known live association, but its subscript selects a nonpointer target element and violates the entire-part condition. The target element is not otherwise initialized; no pointer-lifetime or duplicate-initialization trap.
pending.earlier-pointer-hop: PENDING diagnostic/control: type t has plain INTEGER field v and no default initialization; scalar TARGET,SAVE object base and a pointer q=>base are declared. DATA q%v/7/ is repaired only by replacing q with base. The live base field has no other initializer, so the forbidden earlier pointer hop is not hidden behind an undefined target or count mismatch.
pending.pointer-substring-exclusion: PENDING diagnostic/control with CHARACTER(2),TARGET,SAVE :: t and CHARACTER(2),POINTER :: p=>t, neither target substring initialized: DATA p(1:1)/'X'/, repaired only to DATA t(1:1)/'X'/. A selected substring is not the entire pointer part. The uninitialized second character is never read.

requirements.oracle: Known-live-target contrasts that change only the forbidden pointer path, with valid final-pointer association controls and exact scalar/value counts.
requirements.oracle_limitation: 9.4.2 distinguishes a pointer component considered as a pointer from its dereferenced target; the target is not automatically a base-object subobject. Do not query undefined association status, infer target definition from association, or treat array-pointer initialization as element initialization.

requirements.title: An implied-DO array element is a variable
requirements.definition: An array-element used in the R844 role must be a variable, not an element of a named constant.

pending.variable-element: PENDING compile/positive-control: prior INTEGER a(2), DATA (a(i),INTEGER :: i=1,2)/11,22/. Constant bounds, valid current-index subscripts and exactly two values keep the role isolated.
pending.constant-element-exclusion: PENDING diagnostic/control with prior INTEGER,PARAMETER :: k(2)=[1,2] and separate uninitialized INTEGER a(2): DATA (k(i),INTEGER :: i=1,2)/11,22/. Replace only the object base k with a. Do not remove PARAMETER while retaining a declaration initializer, which would leave forbidden repeated initialization in the control.

requirements.oracle: Resolve variable versus constant-array identity in the actual R844 array-element role and admit the base-name-only repair.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Canonical variable meaning remains9.2/C901. A generic unsupported array constructor or bad index is not this role-specific diagnostic.

requirements.title: An implied-DO scalar structure component is a variable
requirements.definition: The scalar-structure-component alternative in R844 must designate a variable rather than a subobject of a constant.

pending.variable-component: PENDING compile/positive-control with a previously defined public type t containing one plain INTEGER v and no default initialization, plus a(2) of type t; DATA (a(i)%v,INTEGER :: i=1,2)/11,22/. C884's subscript-list premise is supplied by a(i).
pending.constant-component-exclusion: PENDING diagnostic/control with the same type, previously defined TYPE(t),PARAMETER :: k(2)=[t(1),t(2)], and separate uninitialized a(2). Use DATA (k(i)%v,INTEGER :: i=1,2)/11,22/; repair only k to a. Types, index scope, scalar component role and counts stay valid. Constructors and all components are accessible.

requirements.oracle: Exact constant-versus-variable component identity with the required indexed path already present.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Do not omit the indexed parent and accidentally test C884, or leave default/repeated initialization in the control. No private representation is inspected.

requirements.title: An implied-DO scalar component path contains a subscript list
requirements.definition: A scalar-structure-component in the R844 role contains at least one part-ref with a subscript list. The subscript need not be on the final part; indeed the structure-component grammar has no final section-subscript list.

pending.indexed-ancestor: PENDING compile/positive-control for a(1)%v in a one-iteration DATA implied DO, with prior array a(1) of a no-default-initialization type containing scalar INTEGER v. The component is a variable and the sole data constant7 matches the sole expanded object.
pending.unsubscripted-path-exclusion: PENDING diagnostic/control with prior scalar x and array a(1) of that same type: DATA (x%v,INTEGER :: i=1,1)/7/. Replace only x%v by a(1)%v. A single iteration avoids repeated initialization of x%v, so the missing subscript path is not hidden by an occurrence-count error.

requirements.oracle: One-iteration scalar-component path contrast with exactly one value and no prior default or explicit initialization.
requirements.oracle_limitation: A final subscript on a component instead changes the canonical designator to an array element/section under9.4.2 note3. It is not a shortcut to this scalar-structure-component control.

requirements.title: Implied-DO subscripts are constant expressions using only current or enclosing indices
requirements.definition: In a DATA implied-DO array element or scalar structure component, each subscript is a constant expression. A data-i-do-variable primary within it belongs to that implied DO or a containing DATA implied DO.10.1.12 expressly admits the appropriately scoped index primary; this is not a blanket ban on variables in subscripts.

pending.current-index: PENDING compile/positive-control for prior INTEGER a(2), DATA (a(i),INTEGER :: i=1,2)/11,22/. Record i's actual statement-entity scope and integer type, not an assumed executable-loop variable.
pending.containing-index: PENDING compile/positive-control for the nested two-by-two triangular context from R843, where the inner object uses both its j and containing i. All selected elements are distinct and in bounds; the value list has exactly three items.
pending.ordinary-value-exclusion: PENDING diagnostic/control with INTEGER :: a(1), k=1: DATA (a(k),INTEGER :: i=1,1)/7/. Repair only k to1. k is defined but not PARAMETER and not an eligible DATA index; one iteration avoids duplicate initialization. Require nonconstant subscript cause, not an out-of-range or count error.
pending.component-subscript: PENDING the same one-iteration contrast using a(k)%v versus a(1)%v, where a(1) has a previously defined public type with only an uninitialized INTEGER v. Preserve C883/C884 and all pointer-path conditions.
pending.foreign-index-scope-gate: PENDING finite nested/sibling scope map under19.4.
